research_question: Can a local question-conditioned verbatim evidence-span gate distinguish answer-bearing memories from topically related non-answers before the experimental recall shortcut is authorized?

falsifiable_hypothesis.primary: Replacing lexical-overlap authorization with a validated verbatim answer-bearing span will reduce wrong-trace selection and prevent selection after exact target removal on the consumed V1 holdout cases.
falsifiable_hypothesis.paraphrase: The span gate will retain more faithful replacement memories than the lexical gate because it evaluates whether the record contains an answer rather than whether it repeats query words.
falsifiable_hypothesis.failure: The hypothesis fails if target-removed selection is nonzero, wrong-trace selection is not lower than V1, or exact span grounding is below 100%.

single_changed_variable.name: recall_authorization_gate
single_changed_variable.treatment: question-conditioned local model returns a shortest verbatim answer-bearing span, then deterministic validation accepts only exact source-grounded spans
unchanged: no RightBrain, persona, production writes, or VRM actions

development_data.note: These official-derived items were already exposed by V1. They may diagnose and develop V2, but cannot establish generalization or authorize runtime integration.

inference.model_choice_basis: Already installed local model used by existing narrow structured-classification experiments; no model screen is performed in this causal round.
inference.carrier_correction: think=false was locked after a 32/32 empty-content feasibility failure in which every 320-token budget was consumed by Qwen3.5 thinking. No semantic output was observed, and no prompt, schema, case, model, threshold, metric, or gate changed.

span_contract.support_definition: The candidate explicitly contains the value, state, event, time, location, quantity, relation, or negation requested by the question. Topic overlap alone is insufficient.
span_contract.grounding_rule: Every accepted answer_span must be a non-empty verbatim substring of its own candidate text after whitespace normalization only.
fail_closed_rules: invalid JSON rejects all candidates in that call
missing or duplicate source indices reject all candidates in that call
supported=true with an ungrounded or empty span is rejected
supported=false must carry an empty answer_span
the model never receives official answers or expected trace IDs

evidence_boundary.passing_action: Preregister and run one new disjoint full-pipeline holdout.
evidence_boundary.failure_action: Lock the negative result and localize whether the failure is model capacity, span contract, full-record speakability, or score ordering.
